title: tab conversion with a + line deeper than the anchor is refused (E410)
notes: sigma = {'' -> '', 4 SP -> TAB, 8 SP -> 2 TAB} is not a single prefix substitution, and the 12-space + line is outside its domain. The message MUST name that + line; Appendix B has no field for it, so only the level-(a) best candidate is asserted.
